name: menu-builder
description: Phase 4 of the menu build: builds the Joomla skeleton (categories, placeholder articles, menu items) from an approved, human-reviewed Menu Spec JSON. Runs on the Claude Agent SDK using the operator's Claude Code subscription credentials (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or local claude login). Uses Sonnet for the build. Phase 4 is execution against a human-approved spec, but Sonnet gives more reliable idempotent search-then-create behaviour and better recovery from mid-build errors.
